انتدبنا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَدَبْنَا (intadabnā) /in.ta.dab.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
# اُنْتُدِبْنَا (untudibnā) /un.tu.dib.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
